title: Kuch Toh Hai
desc: The movie follows the story of a young couple who move into a new house, only to discover that it is haunted by a mysterious presence. As they try to unravel the truth behind the entity, they uncover a dark secret that threatens their very existence.

title: Raja Ki Aayegi Baaraat
desc: Raja rapes Mala and the court orders him to marry her. His family continues to torture Mala and attempts to kill her, but she manages to win over Raja and his family with her good deeds.

title: Sun Zara
desc: Trisha is mesmerised by aspiring singer Rohit's voice. After the two fall in love, Trisha meets with an accident and loses her eyesight.

title: Kuku Mathur Ki Jhand Ho Gayee
desc: A film about a young man named Kuku who dreams of becoming a successful entrepreneur. When he gets a job at a wedding planning company, he sees it as his ticket to the good life. However, his lack of experience and the chaotic wedding planning industry lead to hilarious mishaps and adventures.
